svg.title: Filter by who created a ticket, what I am watching, and when it last changed — SoftTrack web design mockup (#261)
svg.desc: A list can be sorted by when a ticket was last updated and cannot be filtered by it, and there is no filter for who created a ticket or for what the viewer watches. The filters gain created by, watching, updated and created ranges, more kinds of “has no”, and “me” as a value that a shared view resolves per viewer.
svg.text: Filter by who created a ticket, what I am watching, and when it last changed
· the lists a backlog review starts from
Nothing has happened to these in a month

g.text: the list, where a backlog review starts
Export a sprint as a PDF
Tooltip clipped on the last column
Today the view stores the id of whoever saved it, so a shared view
about “me” shows everybody the same person.

svg.text: Done when the filters include created by, watching, updated and created ranges, and no estimate, no epic and no sprint; “me” is a value, so a shared view saved as assigned to me
shows each viewer their own tickets; all of it lives in the URL and in saved views; and search takes the same filters.

g.text: A list could be sorted by when a ticket
No estimate, no epic, no sprint, beside
the two there were: no assignee and no
Who created it, one person or several,
in the shape every filter now has.
“Assigned to me” means whoever is looking.
Relative ranges for the common questions, dates for the rest.
A search can be narrowed where it is, by the filters a list has.
